orientations.intent: Use Git status to identify the pending incoming provenance card.
Find the pending incoming provenance card details from the dirty repo status

final_message: The Git status check shows the repository (branch `master`) is **not clean** — there is a pending incoming change. This uncommitted/incoming state is the pending provenance card indicator: the repo has unresolved/uncommitted content awaiting processing (i.e., an incoming provenance card not yet merged/committed). No further detail (like file names) is exposed beyond this dirty status via the available Git capabilities, so this dirty status is the identified pending incoming provenance card signal.

files.content: Provenance cards carry origin and owner fields.
